summary: Revised Master Desktop Design System Audit & Alignment Plan incorporating strict domain-context specialization for every toggle and filter. Guarantees that while the container architecture (elevated #F8F9FA pod trays, Seek search lens, segmented pill capsules, and AtriumButton) is unified, every screen's filter options, status pills, and view toggles reflect its authentic vertical context (e.g. medical triage status, garage repair stages, agricultural crop cycles, legal jurisdictions) rather than generic client filters.
